description: This file contains a JUnit test class for ApplicationInfoServiceImpl, testing methods related to fetching application info and handling business exceptions, using Mockito for mocking dependencies.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoServiceImplUTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ApplicationInfoServiceImpl, testing various scenarios of getAppInfo() method including exception handling and normal return.

methods.name: givenAppInfoMapIsNull_whenGetAppInfo_thenThrowBusinessException
methods.description: Tests that getAppInfo() throws BusinessException when the repository returns null.

methods.name: givenAppInfoMapIsEmtpy_whenGetAppInfo_thenThrowBusinessException
methods.description: Tests that getAppInfo() throws BusinessException when the repository returns an empty map.

methods.name: givenAppInfoMapSizeIsMoreThanOne_whenGetAppInfo_thenThrowBusinessException
methods.description: Tests that getAppInfo() throws BusinessException when the repository returns a map with more than one AppInfo.

methods.name: givenAppInfoMap_whenGetAppInfo_thenReturnOneAndOnlyAppInfo
methods.description: Tests that getAppInfo() correctly returns the single AppInfo object when the repository returns a map with exactly one AppInfo.
